cell_interval_convention: left closed; final upper edge included
region_definition: Median individual SOI-exit speed in each occupied 40x40 perilune spatial cell; classify cell by the 8 fixed speed bands
trajectory_colour: region of original perilune cell; not individual speed
perilune_panel: occupied cells filled; only boundaries between differing regions outlined
drawing_order: same deterministic random permutation in both point panels
source_id_hash_encoding: Ordered little-endian int64 source_ids in catalogue order

event_cache_metadata.definition: Physical lunar periapse minimizing (abs(time relative to ETD), signed time); strict time < saved SOI time; full saved GA16 Earth-perigee-to-SOI arc
event_cache_metadata.tie_rule: An exact absolute-time tie chooses the earlier signed time
event_cache_metadata.row_index: All arrays indexed by row of exit_catalog.npy, not source_id
event_cache_metadata.jacobi_drift_definition: Maximum absolute Jacobi drift across nearest and last events

event_selection: Physical lunar periapse with minimum absolute time from ETD=0 within the GA16 arc
speed_reference: Same individual SOI-exit speed as the earlier map; new discrete bands are octiles of occupied-cell median speeds
speed_band_population: 418 occupied spatial cells, each with unit weight; not individual trajectories
colour_definition: Spatial region containing the individual trajectory at the nearest-ETD perilune; same colour transferred to its ETD and perigee
source_join: Identical selected catalog row/source_id at perilune, ETD and perigee
